summary: Admin Panel (backend + frontend) fully tested. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass covering admin stats/users/orgs, suspend cycle with login-403 + token rejection + sessions cleared, role change, delete (with self-protection), org credit set/add/deduct/plan, and grant-all round-trip. Frontend: logged in as admin@aiplatform.com, drove /app/admin – three tabs render, stats visible, user search works, throwaway user suspend→Reactivate→Suspend and 2-step delete via UI all succeed, org +Add/-Deduct/Set update the displayed credits pill in real-time, grant-all round-trip works. Non-admin guard: freshly registered user sees data-testid=admin-denied ('Admin access required.') at /app/admin. No critical or minor issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_api.suspend_user: correctly deletes sessions on suspend – good. Consider also invalidating refresh tokens if stored separately (currently sessions collection is the source of truth).
admin_api.update_org: `if body.add_credits:` treats 0 as falsy which is fine, but if the client explicitly passes add_credits=0 it silently no-ops – acceptable.
grant_all: iterates orgs one-by-one with per-doc update. For 5000+ orgs consider a single aggregation-based update; current volume (~46 orgs) is fine.
Admin.js is compact (~185 lines) and well-structured – no split needed. All interactive elements have data-testid. Toasts are shown on success/error paths.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@aiplatform.com / admin12345 (verified). Throwaway users created via /api/auth/register with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_suspend_*, TEST_role_*, TEST_del_*, TEST_org_*, TEST_ui_*, TEST_guard_*, TEST_admin_throwaway_* users during tests. Some throwaway user auto-created orgs remain (deletion of user does not cascade the org) – informational only, not a bug per current spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin panel is stable. Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_panel.py exercises all admin endpoints. Note: deleting a user does NOT delete their orgs – if that becomes a product requirement it will need a new test.
